messages:
maria: heads up team — customer reported they suddenly get 403s on the console after we completed the org merge earlier today. they can still call the API with their existing API key but console shows permission denied.
jon: any error details from the customer? which project/org?
maria: org: Acme-LLM (org_id: org_9876). affected project: acme-search-prod. customer says clicking into project settings -> permissions returns a 403.
priya: do they use SSO? or org-managed users?
maria: yes SSO via Okta, role mapping to `Redwood-Editor` role. they said role was working before the merge.
support-ian: i pulled the trace — our auth layer returns 403 with message: "principal has no permission: projects.view". audit log shows a role-inheritance failure during the org merge job at 14:07 UTC.
jon: can you paste the audit entry? priya and i will look at mapping.
maria: sure — here's the relevant line from infra-audit:

```
2026-02-18T14:07:03Z INFO org-merger job=org-merge id=merge_2026_02 target=org_9876 status=roles_reconciled warnings=[skipped_inherit:project_id=proj_4422 reason=existing_binding_conflict]
```

priya: hm looks like we skipped inheriting some bindings due to a conflict. our merge job warns but should leave explicit project bindings intact — odd that user lost access.
jon: is the user's identity using SSO group membership or direct user mapping? if SSO group mapping uses `group->org-role` conversion, merge could have temporarily removed group bindings.
maria: customer said their SSO login still yields proper groups in IdP. they can still hit the API using an API key belonging to a service account, but console is complaining because console checks `whoami` and then `projects.list` on the project.
sre-bot: automated-check: role-sync-status for org_9876 -> INCONSISTENT. missing_bindings_count=3. next_retry=2026-02-18T14:12:03Z.
priya: that bot output is interesting — maybe the background role-sync job didn't finish after merge. can we force a resync for that org?
jon: i've run `redwood-admin tools org resync --org org_9876 --force` and got:

```
> resync started for org_9876
status: queued
job_id: rsync_771
```

jon: waiting for job to complete now.
support-ian: customer wants a workaround in the meantime — they are blocked from modifying project settings. suggested temporary fix: invite themselves as a project admin? but they use SSO user accounts, invitation flow won't work for org-managed users.
maria: alternative is to create a short-lived API key with project-admin scope for their ops lead and share securely. customer asked if there's a faster way.
priya: let's check the role inheritance code path. escalation to eng-runtime might be needed if resync doesn't fix it.

sre-bot: job rsync_771 status=running; progress=40%
jon: next step — i pulled token validation logs for one of the affected users. here's a snippet:

```
[14:10:21Z] auth: validate(token=tok_*** user=U123) -> ok groups=[acme-devs,acme-editors]
[14:10:22Z] policy: check(user=U123 project=proj_4422) -> DENY missing=projects.update
```
```

jon: group membership present, so the mapping lookup probably returned no binding for `acme-editors` at the project level.
priya: can we inspect the project's IAM bindings? maria can you fetch `GET /v1/projects/proj_4422/iam` from admin console.
maria: pasted response:

```
{"bindings":[{"role":"projects.viewer","members":["group:acme-viewers@okta.com"]},{"role":"projects.admin","members":["user:ops_lead@acme.com"]}]}
```

maria: acme-editors group not present at project — must have been intended to be inherited but skipped.
jon: resync job just finished:
sre-bot: job rsync_771 status=completed; applied_changes=3; warnings=[binding_conflict_resolved_by_preferring_project_binding]

maria: can you check again, customer still reports 403.
priya: try clearing their console session or invalidate frontend cache; console uses a short-lived session token derived from SSO assertion and caches effective permissions for 5m.
jon: tell customer to sign out and back in — also i dropped a token invalidation for their SSO session via `auth.clean_sessions --user U123`.

maria: customer confirmed: signed out, signed back in — console now shows proper access. they can open project settings. :tada:

support-ian: resolution notes: root cause was org-merge role-inheritance skip due to a binding conflict. resync job applied missing bindings; console sessions cached old effective permissions and required re-login. follow-ups: 1) add merge-time post-check to trigger immediate resync of affected projects; 2) reduce console permissions cache TTL from 5m to 1m for org-merge path; 3) add clearer warning in merge job output to include list of affected projects/users.
priya: filing a follow-up issue in eng-runtime: #INC-1345 — assigning to @jon to pick up the merge post-check and cache TTL change.
jon: will do, ETA EOD tomorrow.
maria: leaving thread open until follow-ups are tracked. marking as customer-resolved for now. :white_check_mark:
